about: The format is closed: a line is read only through the fields the grammar declares, and any other field
refuses the whole line with its name. Lexing a line never admits it; the grammar does.

cases.name: declared fields are a claim
cases.line: bound-lock/1 scope=a role=reads form=alphabet measure=status value=x by=target at=w

cases.name: an undeclared field refuses the line and names it
cases.line: bound-lock/1 scope=a role=reads form=alphabet measure=status value=x by=target at=w colour=red

cases.name: a field the grammar declares is read
cases.line: bound-lock/1 scope=a role=reads form=alphabet measure=status value=x by=target at=w job=j1
